spans.s: लिंग n. 1. A sign, a token, a mark, a characteristic, मुनिर्दोहदलिंगदर्शी R.xiv.71, M.i.30, viii.25; 2. a badge or mark assumed with a view to deceive, स वर्णिलिंगी विदितः समाययौ युधिष्ठिरं द्वैतवने वनेचरः Kir.i.1, किंगैर्मुदः संवृतविक्रियाते R.vii.30; 3. a mark of disease, a symptom; 4. the predicate of a proposition; See हेतु; 5. a means of proof, evidence; 6. a sign of sex; 7. the male organ of generation; 8. gender (in gram.); 9. Śiva’s genital organ worshipped as a representative of him; 10. the image of a god, an idol; 11. an indication which fixes the meaning of a word in a particular context, as in कुपितो मकरध्वजः, where कुपितत्व leads one to understand मकरध्वज in the sense of ‘काम’ K.Pr.ii.; 12. one of the five sheaths that encase the soul (in Vedānta phil.).
लिंग-अग्र m. glans penis.
लिंग-अनुशासन n. the laws of grammatical gender.
लिंग-अर्चन n. worship of Śiva in the shape of a Linga.
लिंग-देह m.n. See (12) above.
लिंग-शरीर n. See (12) above.
लिंग-नाश m. 1. loss of characteristic marks; 2. loss of the penis; 3. a particular disease of the cye.
लिंग-परामर्श m. the consideration of a sign or Hetu (in logic).
लिंग-पुराण n. name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
लिंग-प्रतिष्ठा f. 1. the establishment of a Linga; 2. the consecration of a Linga.
लिंग-विपर्यय m. change of gender.
लिंग-वृत्ति m. a religious hypocrite.
लिंग-वेदी f. the pedestal of a Linga.
लिंगक m. The Kapittha tree.
लिंगन n. Embracing.
लिंगिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having a mark or characteristic; 2. characterized by; 3. bearing false marks, hypocrite; 4. furnished with a Linga.
लिंगिन् (II) m. 1. A Brāhmaṇa ascetic; 2. the worshipper of a Linga; 3. a pretending devotee; 4. the subject of a proposition (in logic); 5. an elephant.
लिंगिन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Having a mark or characteristic; 2. characterized by; 3. bearing false marks, hypocrite; 4. furnished with a Linga.
लिंप m. Smearing, anointing.
लिंपट (I) a. (f. टा) Libidinous, lustful.
लिंपट (II) m. A libertine.
लिंपट (I) a. (f. टा) Libidinous, lustful.
लिंपाक m. 1. The citron tree; 2. an ass.
लीन a. (f. ना) 1. Clung to, adhered to; 2. lurking, hiding, resting on; 3. melted; 4. absorbed, swallowed up; 5. devoted to; 6. vanished, disappeared, (pp. of ली q.v.).
लीन a. (f. ना) 1. Clung to, adhered to; 2. lurking, hiding, resting on; 3. melted; 4. absorbed, swallowed up; 5. devoted to; 6. vanished, disappeared, (pp. of ली q.v.).
